# Abacoa Podiatry & Leg Vein Center

> Complete foot and ankle care in Jupiter, Florida — FDA-cleared MLS laser therapy, shockwave therapy (EPAT), platelet-rich plasma (PRP), regenerative cell treatments, minimally invasive foot surgery (MIS), bunion care, wound care, and the Foot BBL™ fat-pad restoration procedure. The practice's website is jupiterlaser.com.

## Services
- [MLS Laser Therapy](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/mls-laser-therapy/) — FDA-cleared dual-wavelength (808 nm continuous + 905 nm pulsed) class IV laser for pain, inflammation and tissue healing. Painless, 10–15 minute sessions, no downtime, typical course 6–12 sessions.
- [Shockwave Therapy (EPAT)](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/shockwave-therapy/) — acoustic pressure waves for chronic plantar fasciitis and tendinopathy. Typically 3–5 weekly sessions.
- [Foot BBL™](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/foot-bbl/) — minimally invasive plantar fat-pad restoration using Liposana™ (allograft adipose matrix) or Sculptra (poly-L-lactic acid collagen stimulator). No liposuction, no donor site. Treats plantar fat pad atrophy — the "walking on marbles/bones" sensation.
- [PRP Therapy](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/prp-therapy/) — platelet-rich plasma from the patient's own blood.
- [Regenerative Medicine Programs](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/regenerative-medicine/) — staged combinations of the above.
- [Foot & Ankle Surgery](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/foot-ankle-surgery/) — reconstructive and minimally invasive surgery (MIS).
- [Wound Care](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/wound-care/) — diabetic and chronic wound care, limb preservation.

## Common questions, answered
- **Does MLS laser therapy hurt?** No. It is painless — most patients feel nothing or a mild warmth. No needles, no incisions, no downtime.
- **How many laser sessions are needed?** Typically 6–12, scheduled 2–3 times per week. Many patients notice improvement within the first 1–3 sessions.
- **Is laser therapy covered by insurance?** Evaluations and standard podiatric care are usually covered; laser, shockwave and regenerative therapies are typically elective/out-of-pocket. The practice quotes package pricing before treatment begins.
- **What is plantar fat pad atrophy?** Thinning of the natural cushioning under the heel and ball of the foot, causing a "walking on bones/marbles" sensation. Treated with the Foot BBL™.
- **Do I need a referral?** Most patients do not. Some HMO plans require one.
- **How do I book?** Call (561) 624-4800 or request an appointment at https://jupiterlaser.com/contact/. Most new patients are seen within the week.
